cases.why: v2.0 and v2.1 get releases, which would create tags for code that never existed in this repository.
the notes stop quoting the history entry, so a release can say something What's Changed does not.
the workflow stops checking for an existing release, so a second run fails on the first version already released and nothing after it is created.
cases.find:
if gh release view "v$v" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "v$v: already released"
              continue
            fi

cases.why: every push to main starts the Releases workflow, which then runs beside every data commit instead of once per version.
a pushed tag with no history entry releases nothing and the run still goes green, so a missing release is never noticed.
